claim: Each webhook-triggered agent event starts a new, separate conversation rather than continuing a shared session, enabling the agent to handle each event independently with full reasoning transparency reviewable per-event.
stance_target: event-driven trigger architecture should isolate per-event agent context rather than accumulate state in a long-lived session
quoted_support: Every webhook event creates a separate conversation, allowing your agent to handle each event independently with full reasoning transparency.

claim: A platform's built-in managed webhook triggers cover GitHub (PR/issue events), Jira (ticket creation/status changes), Zendesk (support ticket events), Fathom (meeting recordings), and Linear (issue tracking), plus admin-configurable custom webhooks for any other platform.
stance_target: catalog of available managed event-trigger integrations for agent automation
quoted_support: GitHub: PR events, issue updates. Jira: Ticket creation, status changes. Zendesk: Support ticket events. Fathom: Meeting recordings. Linear: Issue tracking events.

claim: Webhook trigger configurations support natural-language filters (e.g., 'Only when ticket contains urgent') layered on top of the structural event type to narrow which events actually invoke the agent.
stance_target: event-driven triggers for continuous agent operation need filterable conditions, not just raw event-type matching
quoted_support: Add optional filter in natural language (e.g., Only when ticket contains "urgent")
